description: Break a confirmed product goal into owned, verifiable work and replan it when new evidence changes value, risk, dependencies, or uncertainty. Use for project planning, task routing, or living-plan updates; not for implementing specialist work.
name: adaptive-task-planning

description: Evaluate memory candidates and safely write, supersede, index, and verify canonical team memory. Use only for long-lived project knowledge governance, not ordinary notes or full-chat archiving.
name: canonical-memory-governance

description: Research users, standards, products, competitors, and ecosystem changes to calibrate a current feature decision. Use when external evidence can change feature correctness or priority; not for speculative trend collection.
name: external-signal-research

description: Review whether a delivered feature solves the intended user problem and matches the approved solution and observable behavior. Use for feature-level correctness, not code-style or local defensive-programming review.
name: feature-correctness-review

description: Implement an approved product change in an isolated worktree and hand it off with deviations, tests, risks, and review evidence. Use for product-code execution after task, context, and solution boundaries are clear.
name: implementation-handoff

description: Run an independent quality gate for an explicitly triggered milestone, release candidate, core journey, cross-repository change, or other high-risk delivery. Do not activate for ordinary issues by default.
name: milestone-quality-gate

description: Retrieve, verify, and package the minimum sufficient project context for a specific task, role, and decision. Use when work needs grounded facts or when context may be missing, stale, conflicting, or polluted.
name: minimum-context-package

description: When a child issue is ready for review, blocked, or stopped, wake Engineering Lead by mentioning them on the PARENT issue. in_review does not auto-wake the parent.
name: parent-handoff-wake

description: Turn an approved goal and grounded context into an implementation-ready technical solution with contracts, compatibility, failure handling, and validation focus. Use for architecture or cross-module design, not coding.
name: solution-design-brief
